_note: Biomes (docs/design/biomes.md section 6 step 3). The farm hub and the five biomes of section 7.1 on the 240 m land (|x| and |z| up to 120 m; x east, z south, the farm at 0, 0). Every number, tint and sign line is a [PLACEHOLDER]. centre and marker are [x, z] in metres. reach_m is how far the biome runs from its centre. bearing_deg is the way out of the farm, 0 north (-z), 90 east, clockwise; the farm has none. role is hub (the farm), spoke (a road out of the farm) or open (the Badlands: the open land between the roads, which takes every point no other biome claims). band is the lab level the content is tuned for (zones.md section 2), never a gate; the Badlands band is the Earthworks 1 to 30 of biomes.md section 2. tint is a ground colour (nothing paints it yet). sign is the soft-gate warning on the biome's marker (a sign and a rover pad on its road; information, never a wall) and names no key. zone_entrance is a zones.json id or null; entrance_at is where that way in already is, or null. Existing places stay where they are: the tunnel mouth (20.5, -19) belongs to the Basalt Ridge, the relay (-70, -70) to the Lab Quarter, and the Aquifer sinkhole is new, in the Badlands (Question 12). Read by scripts/world/biome_data.gd; nothing in play reads it yet.

biomes.name: Farm
biomes.sign: Farm: grow, water, harvest and sleep. Everything starts here.

biomes.name: Lab Quarter
biomes.sign: Lab Quarter: lab level 1 to 20. Instruments, standards and the relay road.

biomes.name: Badlands
biomes.sign: Badlands: Earthworks level 1 to 30. Hills and pits. Deep holes seep water.

biomes.name: Basalt Ridge
biomes.sign: Basalt Ridge: lab level 5 and up. Dark ground, cold nights. The tunnels start here.

biomes.name: Frost Flats
biomes.sign: Frost Flats: lab level 18 and up. Ice, long drives, a heater for the rover.

biomes.name: Landing Field
biomes.sign: Landing Field: lab level 20 and up. The shuttle leaves from here, with a license.
